messages:
julia: heads up — CI integ suite is red on main, failing the integration/metrics tests. job 3421. logs show it can't reach the mock-metrics service (heartbeat timeout). @ci-bot any auto-rerun?
ci-bot: Job 3421 failed: integration/metrics - Exit code 1. Auto-rerun disabled by flaky detection. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/3421
alex: +1, I was looking at this earlier. The `mock-metrics` container on the CI pool shows repeated `ERR: heartbeat timeout` starting at 2026-03-16T03:20:12Z. Likely the mock process crashed and the sidecar didn't restart.
mike: can someone on infra restart the mocks on the affected runner? This is blocking a few PRs. @ops-bot can you take a look?
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Scheduling restart of `ci-mocks` on pool-a (runners: runner-17, runner-18). Restart command: `systemctl restart ci-mocks.service` — ETA ~30s. Will post post-restart logs.
sanjay: if restart doesn't stick, we should pin integration tests to the known-good image `mock-metrics:20260215` until we root-cause. That image passed last night.
laura: I can trigger a rerun once ops confirms restart. @julia want me to rerun 3421 after the restart?
ops-bot: Restart complete on pool-a. Sample logs from runner-17:
```
[03:21:02] mock-metrics: starting
[03:21:03] mock-metrics: heartbeat ok
[03:21:05] mock-metrics: serving /v1/metrics
```
No crash on restart; healthcheck passing.
laura: rerunning job 3421 now.
ci-bot: Rerun job 3421 triggered by laura. Status: running.
ci-bot: Rerun job 3421 PASSED :white_check_mark: all integration/metrics tests green.
julia: nice work — looks transient (mock service flake). i'm opening an issue to track and assigning to @alex to look into the sidecar restart race condition: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/issues/762 :memo:
